Making a tandem skydive with The Skydiving Company is your best bet! Tandem skydiving allows you to experience the incredible thrill of skydiving with no previous training or experience required. It is the safest and most popular way to experience skydiving for the first time. When you make a tandem skydive with us, you’ll be teamed up with one of our expert tandem skydiving instructors who will accompany you throughout your entire skydive. Our brand new skydiving facility is located in Madisonville, TX, right off of I-45 just one hour north of The Woodlands. We are the closest option for outdoor skydiving in The Woodlands, TX. The Skydiving Company is a family-owned and operated business with more than 60 years of experience in the skydiving industry. Our skydiving center caters to skydivers of all skill levels, from first-time tandem skydivers to highly experienced sport jumpers.
